title: Fix CSRF state cookie dropped on login redirect to Atlassian
description: The login route sets btm_oauth_state on a NextResponse.redirect() to auth.atlassian.com. Vercel strips Set-Cookie from 3xx responses, so the cookie never reaches the browser. The callback then sees savedState: undefined and bails with invalid_state. Fix: same 200 HTML + client-side redirect pattern used in the callback.
close_reason: Login route now returns 200 HTML + client-side redirect so btm_oauth_state cookie survives.

title: Fix session cookie dropped on Vercel redirect
description: Vercel strips Set-Cookie headers from 3xx redirect responses. The OAuth callback currently returns NextResponse.redirect() with cookies.set() — the cookie never reaches the browser. Fix by returning a 200 HTML response that sets the cookie and does a client-side redirect via window.location.
close_reason: Callback now returns 200 HTML + client-side redirect instead of 3xx, so Set-Cookie is not stripped by Vercel.
